title: Chicken Kebabs with Syran Sauce
description: A popular Thai street food dish that combines the flavors of chicken, kebabs, and syran sauce. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy meal.
instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, ginger, garlic, and olive oil.
3. Add the chicken breast to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Thread the marinated chicken and kebabs onto skewers.
5. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
6. While the skewers are cooking, heat the syran sauce in a small saucepan over medium heat.
7. Serve the grilled skewers with syran sauce drizzled on top.
